channel_intelligence.state_of_channel: Day 35. 10 subscribers (+1 WoW), ~2,798 lifetime views across the channel (895 -> 2,798, +213% vs the Jul 20 report). The single most important thing this week: the social reel factory had a genuine breakout. 'Bossa nova + coffee = perfect morning' hit 1,032 views - 3.7x the previous channel best (275) and ~20x the best pipeline long - and it drove nearly the entire channel jump. It is a rerun of an earlier morning-coffee caption, and 'A minute of calm for your day' independently repeated its win (275 then 214), so the pattern is now proven repeatable, not a fluke. Meanwhile longs keep doing the quiet work: Studio 28-day watch time climbed to 106.8 hours (+50% WoW), almost all of it from longs. Soft Bossa longs still lead the pipeline (avg 40.3 vs Fun Bossa 26.0), but the Fun long carrying Work&Focus keywords doubled the keyword-less Fun long (52 vs 25) - keywords lift every style. Deep metrics (CTR, impressions, traffic, search terms) remain locked: the Studio Reach/Content sub-tabs will not hydrate via deep-link for the third week running.
what_works: REELS ARE THE GROWTH ENGINE, PROVEN AT SCALE: one reel hit 1,032 views this week ('Bossa nova + coffee = perfect morning'), 3.7x the prior best and ~20x the best long. Reels drove the entire 895 -> 2,798 channel jump.

THE WINNING CAPTION IS REPEATABLE: casual, feeling-first, morning/coffee/calm hooks. 'A minute of calm for your day' won twice (275, then 214 on rerun); the morning-coffee caption went from 58 to a 1,032 breakout. This is a template, not luck.

LONGS = WATCH TIME + SUBS: 106.8 watch hours (+50% WoW) comes almost entirely from longs (8-23 min avg view duration); reels hold ~11s. Subs ticked to 10. Neither format should be cut - reels for reach, longs for watch time and subscribers.

SEARCH KEYWORDS LIFT EVERY LONG: the Fun Bossa long with 'Work & Focus' in the title doubled the keyword-less Fun long (52 vs 25). Soft Bossa still leads longs overall (avg 40.3 vs Fun 26.0), but keyword titles help regardless of style.
next_moves: Make the breakout caption a STANDARD template: mass-produce reels with morning + coffee and calm/breathe feeling captions ('Bossa nova + coffee = perfect morning', 'A minute of calm for your day'). This one format now owns the channel's top 4 videos - weight the reel batch toward it.
Protect the Monday long and keep it Soft Bossa with search-keyword titles (Study/Focus/Work/Sleep) - it is the watch-time and subscriber engine, and Soft still out-pulls Fun on longs.
Keep Work/Focus/Study keywords on EVERY long regardless of style - proven to ~2x view volume even on Fun Bossa.
Keep the Wed/Fri pipeline shorts running for algorithm signal and channel presence (not view volume, per Uri) but borrow the winning reel captions instead of search keywords.

Unlock the CTR/impressions/traffic blind spot: the Reach tab will not hydrate via deep-link - next session navigate Studio in-app by clicking (or screenshot-read the Reach/Content tabs) to finally capture CTR, impressions, traffic sources and top search terms.

Calm Brazilian jazz piano trio for a minute of calm, gentle acoustic piano, upright bass, light brushed snare, no vocals, steady low energy, soothing evergreen background music for reading, breathing and focus

Relaxing bossa nova cafe for deep work and study, nylon guitar, warm Rhodes, muted upright bass, soft percussion, no vocals, consistent unintrusive tempo, long focus-session instrumental with a smooth coffee-shop ambience
channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules: (1) always 'instrumental / no vocals' - this is background music; (2) keep energy CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - focus/sleep/calm listeners leave when a track jumps; (3) bake the LISTENING CONTEXT into the prompt (morning coffee, a minute of calm, deep work, studying, sleep) - it shapes the arrangement toward the audience, and both the winning reel captions AND the top longs carry those same context words; (4) name 2-3 concrete instruments, not just a genre; (5) longs are the compounding watch-time/sub asset - engineer 1hr+ evergreen mixes with Study/Focus/Work search-keyword titles (proven to ~2x views on any style); (6) reels are the raw-view engine and win on CASUAL feeling captions (morning/coffee/calm), NOT search keywords - keep the two title systems separate: search titles on longs, feeling captions on shorts; (7) NEW - the morning-coffee and 'minute of calm' hooks are now proven repeatable (1,032 breakout; caption won twice) - lead the reel batch with them.
